none: PAS CAM-3D3000: Roman Coin : Nummus - VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans (AD 337-50), dating to AD 347-348 (Reece Period 17). Reverse reads VICTORI[AE DD AVG]G Q [NN]. Reverse shows two Victories each holding a small wreath over a leaf. Obverse legend reads CONSTAN - S PF AVG. Obverse shows a rosette diademed, draped and cuirassed bust, right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.14g, diameter is 15.4mm, thickness is 1.3mm. Mint of…
